newsitem.title: USA: APT Satellite ADS's to price in lower range.
newsitem.headline: APT Satellite ADS's to price in lower range.

text.p: The pricing range on APT Satellite Holdings Ltd's initial public offering has been changed to US$16 to US$18.50 per American Depositary Share (ADS) from an earlier range of US$16 to US$20, said underwriter Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
The company, which provides satellite services in the Peoples Republic of China and elsewhere in the Asia-Pacific region, is offering 105 million shares in a global offering.
Of these, 52.5 million shares are slated for the United States and Canada, 42 million for international placement, and 10.5 million for Hong Kong.
Eight shares will make up one ADS.
